name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: Build polished AI-powered presentations that actually look like you made them.
problem: Generic AI presentation tools produce cookie-cutter slides that undermine credibility and brand identity. Chronicle 2.0 addresses the gap between AI-assisted speed and professional-quality output, giving teams a way to create visually refined decks without the telltale signs of AI-generated slop. This is especially valuable for client-facing work where presentation quality signals competence.
useCases: Creating investor pitch decks with a distinctive, on-brand visual style
Building client-ready sales presentations quickly without designer involvement
Producing internal strategy decks that maintain executive-level polish
Repurposing existing content into structured slide narratives using AI
